clues.text: A disciple in Joppa, she was always busy with works of kindness and charity.
In Joppa, weeping widows showed Peter the tunics and other clothing this woman had made.
When this Joppa disciple fell sick and died, her body was washed and laid in an upper room.
After she died, the disciples in Joppa sent two men to nearby Lydda, urging Peter to come without delay.
In an upper room in Joppa, Peter knelt and prayed, then told her to get up, and she opened her eyes and sat up.
Peter took this Joppa woman by the hand, helped her up, and presented her alive to the saints and widows.
News that Peter raised this woman spread all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
